t: You're facing the front of what was the Shepherd's Bush Palladium. It began in 1910 as the Shepherd's Bush Cinematograph Theatre and stopped showing films in 1981. It later became a pub, long run by the Walkabout chain. In 2019 the building was largely demolished and in 2021 replaced by a sixteen-storey block of flats, keeping the original 1920s facade, which is what you see. The cinema was designed by J. Stanley Beard, an architect known for designing many cinemas in and around London.
